FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Eternal Rest Funeral Services, we provide compassionate and professional funeral and cemetery services to families in their time of need. Our core operations include the respectful handling and preparation of the deceased, coordinating memorial services, and managing burial and cremation arrangements. We maintain an inviting funeral home equipped with comfortable facilities for visitations and services, and we employ licensed funeral directors and embalmers who meet all state regulations. Additionally, our cemetery services encompass the sale of burial plots, the maintenance of our grounds, and the provision of memorial options. To ensure the highest standards of care and sanitation, all staff undergo comprehensive training in safety protocols. We are committed to maintaining compliance with all local and state regulations, which includes holding all necessary licenses for our operations.
